chunks: From him, from one of his companions, raising it (to the Prophet or Imam), said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The carnelian is a safety during the journey'.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of carrying carnelian (aqeeq) during travel according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (asws) identifies the 'aqeeq' (carnelian) as a talisman for safety during travel, reflecting the broader Shia tradition of attributing spiritual and physical protection to specific natural stones. This narration underscores the belief in tangible means (asbab) of divine safeguarding, linking material objects to spiritual well-being in the context of journeying.
